title: Engagement, Motivation, and Learning Outcomes in CBI and EMI Language Clubs: A Comparative Study to Strengthen Bilingual Capacity in Engineering Programs at Institución Universitaria Pascual Bravo.
description: This project aims to analyze and compare the impact of Content-Based Instruction (CBI) and English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) methodologies on student engagement, motivation, and learning outcomes in the context of bilingual language clubs at Institución Universitaria Pascual Bravo.
